text:
alice: FYI support ticket: streamed session got preempted -> fallback -> truncated tool call then replayed on reconnect, ended up billed twice.
ben: rough. session id?
alice: si_32f, router rt-b. Logs: router preempt->fallback, model truncated, toolcall id=tcA provisional, reconnect sent same suffix and confirmed.
clara: current dedupe is per-route so replay on different route missed it.
dan: options: global toolcall dedupe, or route-aware confirm gating (only confirm if same origin route).
ben: global dedupe is ideal but we need to estimate lookup QPS. could be small LRU cache keyed by toolcall id.
clara: short-term we should block auto-confirm if confirming_route != origin_route and keep provisional until TTL+reconciler. prevents immediate double-confirm.
alice: customer billed ~600 tokens extra and wants console visibility.
ben: console ask: show origin_route for provisional entries and mark flips. I'll add a dashboard tile and alert for flips >0.1%.
dan: also propose adding a tiny resume header carrying recent toolcall ids so runtime can drop duplicates earlier. low-risk change in router handshake.
clara: I'll prototype the dedupe cache (LRU in memcache + fallback to ledger read). ETA two weeks.
alice: I'll prepare support guidance and a refund script. billing-bot: ping @billing-team -- please review refund window policy for these cases.
clara: PR incoming with spec for global dedupe and route-gating.
dan: also add nightly reconciler to sweep stale provisionals if we go with gating.
alice: action owners: clara=dedupe prototype, ben=dashboard+console column, dan=resume-header+router-guard, alice=support note/refund. Locking thread for follow-ups.
